glosses: which is result of a previous quality or condition

examples.text: Tom viu seu reflexo no espelho.
examples.en: Tom saw his reflection in the mirror.

examples.text: Eu vi o meu reflexo na janela.
examples.en: I saw my reflection in the window.

examples.text: Nós podíamos ver o reflexo das montanhas no lago.
examples.en: We could see the reflection of the mountains in the lake.

examples.text: Eu vi o reflexo de Tom na janela.
examples.en: I saw Tom's reflection in the window.
